intro: Part 3: advantages and costs. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: Texts about the energy transition compare goals and constraints. Distinguish measured data, forecasts and priorities; a concession acknowledges a cost without necessarily abandoning the thesis.
